free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS 5 score directly meets the cohort criterion, which is the rule that fired in the panel protocol. This decision is strongly supported by the PI-RADS 5 finding and the fact that the patient has never been biopsied. The evidence converged on biopsy, as confirmed by the Verifier, based on the direct application of the EAU guideline criteria.
